VISITE // CENTRALE N° 3, ATELIER DES C: VISIT  //  POWER STATION NO. 3, BOILER HALL
Cliquez sur un endroit de l'image pour l: Click a spot on the image to examine it. The bulletin is at 8 p.m.: every hour here is an hour less.
L'atelier sent encore la suie et l'huile:
The hall still smells of soot and hot oil. Boiler No. 2 is nothing but a black hole behind a tarpaulin; its twin, No. 1, is still running, "priority production".

A militiaman guards the door. "Ten minutes, Inspector. Captain ORLIK said: nobody touches anything."
La chaudière n° 1, jumelle de celle qui: Boiler No. 1, twin of the one that blew
Sur le flanc de la n° 1, le logement de:
On the side of No. 1, the housing of the safety valve. There is no valve: a bolt, braided hemp, a piece of wire. A makeshift plug, fitted by hands that knew what they were doing and had nothing else.

No. 2 was fitted the same way. It took no explosive and no saboteur.
Les vannes de la conduite principale: The valves on the main pipe
Chaque vanne porte une étiquette cartonn: Each valve carries a card tag, yellowed by steam: "Part ordered 09.86 — approved L. O. — pending". Six tags. The oldest dates from March.
Le tableau de commande, au mur: The control panel on the wall
Le levier d'arrêt d'urgence est ligaturé: The emergency stop lever is tied down with wire. A tag hangs from it: "DO NOT STOP — priority production — by order, 14.11". Three days before the explosion.
Le registre de quart, accroché à la port: The shift log, hanging on the door
Le registre de quart de la nuit du 16 au: The shift log for the night of the 16th to the 17th, written in grease pencil. Last line in Jonas RUDA's hand: "02h00 — valve No. 2 whistling. Request shutdown. Refused by phone (captain's office)." He died ten minutes later.
Sous les marches de la passerelle: Under the steps of the catwalk
Un petit carnet à spirale, tombé entre d:
A small spiral notebook, fallen between two steps. Mira SEDLAR's apprentice notebook: she noted the pressure every hour, for RUDA. Last line, 01h45: "16 bar. RUDA says don't touch, he's calling."

The "saboteur" was taking the readings.
Le seau et la pelle, près du foyer: The bucket and shovel by the firebox
Sur le manche de la pelle, peint en blan: On the shovel's handle, painted in white: "RUDA". Tucked under the bucket's handle, a photo of two children in front of a fir tree. The militiaman looks away. Nothing for the file.
You dig through the coal up to your elbow. No detonator, no wrapping, no fuse. Damp coal, poor quality. The militiaman watches you get your hands dirty without a word.
Le milicien referme la porte derrière vo: The militiaman shuts the door behind you. In the yard, the shift siren sounds as if nothing had happened. It is almost time for the bulletin.
